# Snowball Pro

> Snowball Pro is a free French wealth and retirement simulator. It projects
> your savings (starting capital + monthly contributions) using the real
> returns of the MSCI World (1970–2025) plus 100 years of history (S&P 500
> SBBI 1926–1969), applies French taxation (CTO, PEA, AV, PER — 2026 rules),
> and measures plan robustness with Monte Carlo (up to 10,000 scenarios) and
> decumulation (Guyton–Klinger guardrails, 1973/2000/2008 stress tests).

## Key facts

- Free, no sign-up, no account required (accounts are optional and local-only)
- 100% local: data never leaves the device (localStorage); works offline (PWA)
- Available in French and English
- No advertising, no data resale, no cookies
- Historical data: MSCI World net returns 1970–2025 (EUR), S&P 500 SBBI
  1926–1969, French INSEE inflation 1970–2025
- French tax year 2026 modeled: flat tax (PFU) 31.4% on CTO gains; PEA exempt
  from income tax after 5 years (18.6% social contributions); life insurance
  (AV) excluded from the 2026 CSG increase (17.2%); PER deductible on entry,
  taxed at exit
- Pedagogical rate chain: gross 10.07% → compounded 8.22% → real 5.99%
  (MSCI World 1970–2025, 2.1% inflation assumption — the period median)

## FAQ

- Q: Is Snowball Pro free?
  A: Yes — completely free, with no sign-up required and no paywall.
- Q: Where do the return assumptions come from?
  A: Real historical returns of the MSCI World (1970–2025) and S&P 500
  (1926–1969), not promised returns.
- Q: Is this investment advice?
  A: No. Snowball Pro provides educational simulations based on historical
  data; past performance does not predict future results.
